title: The CI-done wake fires in the cloud, where a PR is marked ready through the GitHub MCP tool
why: Owner 11:55 CST Nov 11: "the wake-up that tells a session CI is done never fires in the cloud -- how the fuck is that possible and how have we not figured out how to address it".
note: Cause (debt ci-wake-misses-mcp-ready): hooks/ci_wake.py's PostToolUse matcher in settings.json listens only to the Bash and PowerShell gh ready command; cloud sessions mark ready with the MCP update_pull_request call. Fix: also match the MCP ready call (draft false); red case first, from a recorded MCP ready payload. Close the debt when it lands. Plan 0d3a757. Owner wants it raised now, not left as a debt.
source: owner 2026-11-11 11:55 CST, relayed by the retrospective session
